description: Magnetic flowmeter transmitter with Modbus RS-485: flow rate, totalizers, diagnostics and meter verification values, status words and coils, configuration, slot (scan list) values
source: Emerson, Rosemount 8732EM Transmitter with Modbus Protocol Reference Manual, 00809-0400-4444 Rev AC (August 2024), appendix C

sources.title: Rosemount 8732EM Transmitter with Modbus Protocol Reference Manual
sources.note: appendix C, Modbus coil and register map

notes: Modbus RTU on RS-485; address, baud rate, parity and stop bits are registers 109 and 115-117.
Register and coil numbers are those of the manual, counted from 1 (the manual says some masters need 1 subtracted), so this map uses address_base 1.
Floats are two registers; register 110 sets the byte order (0-1-2-3 by default). This map assumes the default is plain big endian; check one value on the device.
U8 values are 8-bit values held in one register. Flow and totalizer units follow the unit registers 61-64.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
